justification: Panel A shows schematic red anthropomorphic stick figures, curvilinear scrolls, a ring/circle motif, and abstract linear marks arranged loosely across a rock surface, while panel B shows a rectangular monument covered in tightly packed rows of glyph-like blocks with intricate carved conventions, plus a seated human figure for scale. There is no correspondence in the kinds of motifs (stick figures and scrolls vs. dense glyphic blocks), their relationships, arrangement, or stylistic conventions of depiction.
